name: Gyűrűs (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light grey at the hoist and green at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gyűrűs: a blue shield with a white dove and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gyűrűs arms with helm, crest and mantling
